compatibility.legacyContracts: runtimeContext omitted/empty retains original canonical hash; 12-argument constructor retained
compatibility.legacyEvents: Original constructor and fields retained; payload additive
compatibility.datasetLimit: Existing 1..8 datasets, immutable manifest and chunk hashes preserved

configuration.authority: Existing Java parent model binding and SkillAnalysisContext; no worker model catalog or secrets
configuration.consistency: TASK_SNAPSHOT; changed authorized model configuration requires a distinct task; JSON number normalization preserves replay
configuration.skills: Configured identifiers, validated loaded methodology and actual prompt application/tool executions displayed separately

execution.authority: Java validates scope, operation binding, path main.py, 256 KiB size and exact SHA before existing Sandbox dispatch
execution.sourceStorage: Immutable private evidence, source fetched only on demand with tenant/owner checks; hashes/events contain no full source
execution.completion: Existing durable journal plus output contract and parent semantic admission; worker text cannot authorize completion
execution.dispatchStage: Existing CODE startIntent is RECOVERY_RECONCILED with stage EXECUTING (submitted/waiting for execution receipt), not a fabricated EXECUTION_STARTED confirmation. Verified stop proof advances RESULT_VALIDATING.

phaseCompatibility: Monitor derives presentation phases from persisted native task/execution events without replacing existing durable task states. FAILED/CANCELLED remain authoritative terminals; DEADLINE_EXCEEDED stop/reason projects TIMED_OUT.

events.ordering: Durable sequence cursor, eventId deduplication, limit<=256, expired compacted cursors explicit
events.retention: Existing bounded journal enlarged from 128 to 8192 events; no invented restoration of already-compacted legacy records

controls: Owner/tenant and native state required. Resume reconciles original operation receipts/checkpoints; it is not new-budget retry. Unsafe retry is not exposed.
limitations: Complete source submissions update live; provider partial tokens are not rendered as fake code drafts.
Unknown provider/executor outcomes retain reservations until stop/receipt evidence; no blind retry.
External cleanup deleted historical Sandbox directories; live isolation config restored, historical deleted files cannot be recreated from metadata.
